message: In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), the fifty 20 kilogram manual crates have ergonomic strain problem for cooperative members, Sam. To check it I used payload review reusing the total payload check (E7). I found 1000 kilograms total from fifty 20 kilogram crates suited to waist-height handling, according to International Labour Organization guidance on manual loads, 2018. I propose ground-level door with no step plus twin racks with low tier above knee height and two-person rule above shoulder. My position: not ready because thermal sign-off by you on infiltration discipline is still pending. In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), the shared crate washing and fee upkeep has neglect and rot spread problem, Manager. To check it I used operations review reusing the 4-day staged fill schedule (E12). I found 250 kilograms per day intake allowing daily wash and inspection, according to Food and Agriculture Organization post-harvest handling guide, 2023. I propose external wash slab with chlorinated water plus pay-per-crate box with trained local caretaker and locally welded rack repair. My position: not ready because solar autonomy closure by Sam and Maya remains open.
